subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Starts Now!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive summer sale with up to 50% off on select items! Whether you're looking for trendy summer outfits or stylish accessories, we've got you covered. Don't miss out on this limited-time offer to upgrade your summer wardrobe. Visit our website or store today to shop the latest fashion trends at unbeatable prices. Hurry, the sale ends soon! Happy shopping!
